fusions.name: Heaved Clod
fusions.desc: Heaves a clod at a target up to 6 tiles away, dealing 14 damage, up to 1.8 times that at full reach, and stunning it for 1 second.

fusions.name: Churned Ground
fusions.desc: Churns the earth around you, dealing 7 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles. Costs 4% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Pitfall
fusions.desc: Digs a pit trap onto the nearest enemy. It waits 60 seconds, and the first 2 enemies to come within 3 tiles take 24 damage in a blast around it.

fusions.name: Dug In
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 40%, you gain a ward that soaks 30% of your maximum health for 6 seconds.
